mapper.sql: select s.id, s.user_id, s.store_id, s.shift_id, s.skill_id, s.schedule_date, s.version, u.nick_name as user_name, sh.name as shift_name, sh.code as shift_code, sh.start_time as shift_start_time, sh.end_time as shift_end_time, sh.color_code as shift_color_code, sk.name as skill_name from hrp_schedules s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join hrp_shifts sh on sh.id = s.shift_id left join hrp_skills sk on sk.id = s.skill_id
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.store_id, s.shift_id, s.skill_id, s.schedule_date, s.version, u.user_name AS user_name, sh.name AS shift_name, sh.code AS shift_code, sh.start_time AS shift_start_time, sh.end_time AS shift_end_time, sh.color_code AS shift_color_code, sk.name AS skill_name, -- 计算考勤状态 CASE WHEN exc.exception_type IS NOT NULL THEN exc.exception_type WHEN rec.id IS NULL THEN '缺勤' WHEN rec.clock_in_time > ADDTIME(CONCAT(s.schedule_date, ' ', sh.start_time), '00:05:00') THEN '迟到' WHEN rec.clock_out_time < CONCAT(s.schedule_date, ' ', sh.end_time) THEN '早退' ELSE '正常' END AS attendance_status FROM hrp_schedules s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN hrp_shifts sh ON sh.id = s.shift_id LEFT JOIN hrp_skills sk ON sk.id = s.skill_id LEFT JOIN hrp_attendance_records rec ON rec.schedule_id = s.id LEFT JOIN hrp_attendance_exceptions exc ON exc.user_id = s.user_id AND exc.exception_date = s.schedule_date WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY s.schedule_date, sh.start_time
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO hrp_schedules (user_id, store_id, shift_id, skill_id, schedule_date, version) VALUES
